workGoals.title: 45-day goals
workGoals.description: Set a goal for the cycle, post progress, and get it verified by your manager.
workGoals.emptyBody: Create a goal for this cycle to start tracking progress.

create.title: New goal
create.description: A goal runs for one cycle (45 days by default). Your manager verifies it when you finish.
create.name: Goal
create.targetHint: Filled automatically as start date + 45 days. You can change it.
create.targetValueHint: Optional, for example 30. Progress is then calculated from the value you post.

errors.badNumber: Enter a number with up to 2 decimals
errors.dateOrder: The target date cannot be before the start date

detail.notFoundBody: It may have been removed, or you may not have access to it.
detail.onlyOwner: Only the goal owner can post progress.
detail.noTasks: No tasks are linked to this goal.
detail.tasksHidden: You do not have access to work tasks.
detail.pendingBody: This goal was submitted. Progress is locked until the reviewer verifies it or returns it.
detail.pendingMine: You submitted this goal. {name} will verify it or send it back.
detail.needsSubmit: Progress is at 100%. Submit the goal so it can be verified.
detail.overdueTitle: This goal is past its target date
detail.riskBody: Progress is {progress}% while {elapsed}% of the cycle has passed.

actions.submitBody: Your reviewer will check it. You cannot change progress while it is waiting.
actions.completeBody: No verification is required by your organisation's policy.
actions.verifyBody: The goal will be marked completed.
actions.returnBody: The owner will be asked to continue. Explain what is missing.
actions.cancelBody: A cancelled goal cannot be reopened. Say why it is being cancelled.

workGoals.editDescription: Changes are saved on the current version. If someone else changed the goal first, reload and try again.
